name: intblock_lookup
description: Look up an international organization or group (intblock) by id, name, Wikidata id, or membership. Join members on includes[].id / memberships.country_code, never includes[].name.

id.description: Uppercase intblock id, e.g. NATO, EU. Check intblocks_aliases.json for renames.

member_country.description: Alpha-2 country code to find orgs containing this member.

blocktype.description: Primary taxonomy key, e.g. political, bank, sports.
